outcome: amend --follows links an open outcome to closed outcomes it follows up, limited to outcomes sealed before it, so a forgotten begin --follows can be added later without breaking the thread
criteria: inkan amend --follows <id>, repeatable, records each named closed outcome in the amend event, and status and log show it like a begin link
amend --follows refuses a malformed, unknown, or still-open id, and an outcome sealed after the amended outcome, and appends nothing
log <id> finds an outcome linked by amend --follows in the thread of the outcome it follows
Inkan 0.7.0 still reads a record with an amend --follows link
inkan help, README.md, and README.zh.md document amend --follows; decision 0020 history records the change

dispositions.note: verified by running the installed 0.7.0 log <id> and doctor against a record linked by amend --follows; the hash matched

note: amend --follows adds links to the open outcome and refuses an outcome sealed after it, so a follow-up is always sealed after what it follows and the UTC-day scan in log <id> stays sound; the thread scan now reads links from amend events too. Time zones never affected the scan, since ids are UTC. Protocol 14 is unchanged; decision 0020 history records the change.
